meaning: First current-dependency browser attempt could not launch: Playwright headless-shell was absent. No browser behavior is qualified by this attempt. A rerun uses the existing system Chromium through the supported executable option.

updates.meaning: The system Chromium rerun reached server startup but a stale PostgreSQL socket from the first disposable browser instance prevented startup. The recorded PID is a zombie and no TCP listener remains; only the exact stale socket and socket lock were removed. Its database/source files were preserved. No browser assertion ran.
